parameter: EIA 2.1 Water: cooling water temperature rise across the condenser at most 7 K
remarks: ALP-EPC-00PAA-ME-CAL-0001 (CW sizing and hydraulic calculation); ALP-IEC-10MBA-PR-HMB-0001; ALP-EPC-00000-PR-HMB-0001 (plant heat balance, checks); ALP-EPC-00000-PR-STU-0003. Status open (TQ-IEC-026, see 5.1).
value_text: The circulating water flow (DEC-EPCE-0002) and the condenser are to keep the rise at or below DP-CASE-0015 in steady state in all ambient conditions (TQ-041). NOT MET in the cold cases: with the constant CW flow of the heat balance the rise is 7.20 K (MIN-NG-100) and 7.28 K (WIN-NG-100). IEC to raise the condenser design CW flow with the tube count and re-issue the cases (TQ-IEC-026); the hmb engine checks the rise of every case against DP-CASE-0015. Start-up and trip bypass transients up to 60 min are reported monthly (TQ-041).
